definitions.explanation: Based on or relating to theory rather than practical application.

examples.japanese: {理論的|りろんてき}⟦には→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{可能|かのう}→可能：00175_kanou⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
{理論的|りろんてき}な⟦{背景|はいけい}→背景：28348_haikei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
{理論的|りろんてき}な⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{実験|じっけん}→実験：03273_jikken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{両方|りょうほう}→両方：01750_ryouhou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: Both theoretical research and experiments are important.

notes:
{理論的|りろんてき} is a na-adjective meaning theoretical, relating to theory rather than practice.

FORMS:
⟦{理論|りろん}→理論：04708_riron⟧ (theory) + ⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧ (suffix making na-adjectives)
- Adverb: {理論的|りろんてき}に (theoretically)
- Modifying nouns: {理論的|りろんてき}な + noun

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {理論的|りろんてき}⟦には→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{可能|かのう}→可能：00175_kanou⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧: it's theoretically possible
- {理論的|りろんてき}な⟦{根拠|こんきょ}→根拠：10147_konkyo⟧: theoretical basis
- {理論的|りろんてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{考|かんが}える→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧: to think theoretically

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{実践的|じっせんてき}→実践的：05690_jissenteki⟧: practical
- ⟦{現実的|げんじつてき}→現実的：04794_genjitsuteki⟧: realistic
